title: FindingNemo Extraction 4: Circulomics Kit
author: Inswasti Cahyani
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bxvwpn7e
materials: Follow the manufacturer’s instructions as described here .

steps.title: Prepare extraction with Nanobind kit
steps.instruction: Use the Nanobind CBB Big DNA Kit (Circulomics) as described in the Materials section to extract high‑molecular‑weight DNA.

steps.title: Store or proceed to library prep
steps.instruction: After extraction, either store the DNA at 4 °C or continue directly to UL Library Preparation as detailed in Section “Modified ULK001”. If only the SQK‑RAD004 kit is available, follow the library preparation described in Section “Modified RAD004” (or use the KrazyStarFish (KSF) protocol).

substeps.instruction: Store the DNA at 4 °C for short‑term storage.
If proceeding, follow Section “Modified ULK001” for UL Library Preparation.
If SQK‑RAD004 is the only kit, follow Section “Modified RAD004”.

steps.title: Quantify DNA after incubation
steps.instruction: After an overnight incubation at room temperature, quantify the DNA using the “UHMW DNA QC” method and assess sample homogeneity by calculating the percent coefficient of variation (%CV).

substeps.instruction: Incubate the DNA sample overnight at room temperature.
Perform DNA quantification according to the “UHMW DNA QC” protocol.
